selector.rationale: The patient's Holter monitor recording showed a 23.8-second ventricular asystole during syncope, which is consistent with vagus-mediated paroxysmal atrioventricular block (VP-AVB). The absence of structural heart disease and the presence of a spontaneous junctional escape beat also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Sick Sinus Syndrome
rejected.why: No evidence of persistent sinus node dysfunction

rejected.label: Atrioventricular Block
rejected.why: The asystole was transient and followed by a spontaneous junctional escape beat, suggesting a paroxysmal rather than a persistent block
